rules.working_source_interpretation_NOT_origin: Mixed movable/common signs cause intermittent rather than uninterrupted travel.

Specific natal travel significator signs are cited without independent chart data.

rules.working_source_interpretation_NOT_origin: Mars is located at a western chart angle.
